comment: each case is one enrollment request: .cbor is the request, .txt its bech32m form with a trailing newline, .json its fields and the SHA-256 of its signature preimage. `form` is `canonical` for the lowercase form SPEC 16.2 defines, and `uppercase` for the same request in the form 16.2 says a reader MUST also accept; an uppercase case names the canonical one it duplicates, and only its .txt differs
